scene: The first altar at dawn: a simple platform of unhewn stacked stones on a bare hilltop above the wild valley, morning mist below, the light just reaching the stones — empty, waiting, already sacred. No people yet.
must_show: a rough unhewn stone altar alone on a dawn hilltop over mist
must_not_show: carvings, tools, fire yet, people, drawn rays

scene: The family that kept praying: Adam and Eve kneel side by side outside their timber-and-stone dwelling in evening light, heads bowed, his hand over hers on the earth between them — seen from the side at a respectful distance, smoke from a cook-fire rising thin behind the roofline.
must_show: the first couple kneeling side by side at evening, his hand over hers on the ground, side view
must_not_show: faces to camera, tears, an altar in this frame

scene: Heaven answers: both faces lift together — Adam's and Eve's profiles caught at the instant of hearing, eyes opening toward the evening sky, wonder without fear — the wind moving her long hair and the fire's smoke sideways in the same gust.
must_show: two lifted listening profiles, wind moving hair and smoke the same direction, wonder
must_not_show: any figure in the sky, faces to camera, drawn light

scene: The angel's question: beside the hilltop altar a radiant MESSENGER — a glorified man in a bright white robe, both feet planted on the ground — stands facing Adam across the smoking altar stones, mid-question with one open hand toward the offering; Adam faces him in worn work-clothes, straight-backed, honest. Both in profile to the camera, morning light hard and clean on the hilltop.
must_show: a wingless white-robed messenger and Adam in facing profiles across a smoking stone altar
must_not_show: wings, halo, hovering, Adam kneeling in fear, faces to camera

scene: The honest answer: Adam's face close in three-quarter, mid-sentence — the plain unashamed look of a man saying I don't know, but He commanded — weathered features open, no performance, morning light on the honesty itself.
must_show: Adam's close three-quarter mid-answer, plain unashamed honesty
must_not_show: his eyes on the lens, shame, tears, the angel in frame

scene: The similitude lands: sharp in the foreground, the white firstling lamb lying bound and still upon the altar wood; soft beyond it, Adam's face coming up with widening eyes as the meaning arrives — the lamb and the understanding in one frame, the smoke rising thin and straight between them.
must_show: the bound white lamb sharp on the altar, Adam's soft-focus widening understanding beyond
must_not_show: blood, knife, distress in the lamb, faces to camera

scene: The first congregation: the family kneels in a half-circle before the hilltop altar at full morning — Adam, Eve, and seven children from grown sons to a toddler on a sister's hip — all seen from behind and beside, every head toward the straight-rising smoke, the wild world enormous beyond the hill.
must_show: the whole first family kneeling from behind before the altar's straight smoke, wild world beyond
must_not_show: faces to camera, buildings, drawn rays

scene: Eve the teacher: firelight inside the dwelling — Eve mid-story with both hands shaping something in the air, four children cross-legged before her, the nearest boy's mouth open, every young gaze on her hands — the gospel passing to the second generation in the oldest classroom there is.
must_show: Eve mid-story by firelight, hands shaping the air, rapt children before her
must_not_show: faces to camera, scrolls, books, sadness

scene: The first baptism: Adam BURSTS up out of a clear river pool at dawn — caught at the exact instant of emerging, water sheeting off his head and beard, arms rising, face heavenward with closed eyes — alone in the water, carried there by a power the frame does not show. The pool's far bank is stone and young green; the light is first gold.
must_show: Adam mid-burst from the river pool, water sheeting, face heavenward, alone in frame
must_not_show: an officiator visible, swimmers' strokes, his eyes on the lens, cold colours

scene: New: Adam stands waist-deep and still in the pool, streaming, his face carrying the unmistakable look of a man made new — and on the near bank Eve stands with both hands pressed over her mouth, joy running over. Both in profile, dawn gold on the water between them.
must_show: Adam waist-deep made-new and Eve on the bank with hands over her mouth, joy, dawn water between
must_not_show: faces to camera, towels, crowd, tears of grief

scene: The same gospel, today: a river baptism in the present day — a man in white being lowered back toward the water by a baptizer's braced arms, both figures seen from behind and beside at a distance, a small family group watching from the grassy bank, morning light broad on the river. Faces away or in profile; timeless.
must_show: a present-day river baptism from behind-beside, braced arms mid-lowering, small family watching from the bank
must_not_show: faces to camera, church buildings, signage, brand marks

scene: The turn: the family camp at dusk — and at its edge, past the last tent, one cold unlit fire-ring of blackened stones where nobody sits, the warm lit fires and moving figures soft in the background. Something has started to pull at the edges — and the cold ring sits empty.
must_show: a cold unlit fire-ring at the camp's dusk edge, warm living fires soft beyond
must_not_show: any figure at the cold ring, smoke from it, faces readable

scene: The counterfeit sermon: night — a loose crowd of Adam's younger kin gathered at the camp's edge, every face lit faintly by the distant family fires BEHIND them while they stand turned the other way, listening intently toward the empty darkness beyond the camp — heads tilted, some nodding slowly, fascination dulling their faces. The darkness they attend to is EMPTY: open night, no speaker, no shape.
must_show: a night crowd turned away from the warm fires, listening raptly toward empty open darkness
must_not_show: ANY figure, silhouette or shape in the darkness they face; anyone facing the lens; torches among them

scene: Doubt as doctrine: one strong young man stands with his back deliberately turned to the distant altar hill — arms folded hard, jaw set, seen in profile against the morning light that still reaches him from the hill he refuses — the first posture of a very long tradition.
must_show: a young man in profile, arms folded, back turned to the distant lit altar hill
must_not_show: sneering, his eyes on the lens, weapons, darkness on him

scene: The imitation church: a big night feast-fire down in the valley — figures laughing too loudly around it, wine skins lifted, a whole roast dripping, someone dancing with a thrown-back head — appetite worshipped, seen from just outside the fire's ring so every face is toward the flames or each other, none toward the lens. Shot kept modest: revelry, not depravity.
must_show: a loud firelit feast of appetite — lifted wine skins, dripping roast, thrown-back laughter — none facing the lens
must_not_show: nudity, violence, anyone facing the lens, modern objects

scene: The split: at a fork in the camp trail at dusk, two grown brothers part — one walking up-trail toward the altar hill's evening light, one walking down toward the feast-fire's flicker in the valley — both seen from directly behind at the fork, their shoulders already a world apart. The camera stays low between the two paths.
must_show: two brothers from behind parting at a fork — one toward the lit hill, one toward the valley fire-flicker
must_not_show: faces or profiles, weapons, anyone else in frame

scene: The headline restated: the altar hill at full sunrise — the family gathered close around the burning offering, the smoke rising straight into a sky gone entirely gold, every figure from behind or profile in the half-circle — the first church on earth, complete and glorious and small against the enormous morning.
must_show: the family half-circle around the burning altar under a full-gold sunrise, smoke straight up
must_not_show: faces to camera, drawn rays, any darkness

scene: The next generation reaches: close — a baby in Eve's arms at the altar's edge, one tiny arm stretched out toward the bright smoke and morning light, Eve's cheek against the small head, both faces soft in profile.
must_show: a baby in Eve's arms reaching one arm toward altar smoke and light, profiles
must_not_show: faces to camera, distress, harsh light on the child

scene: Your family's turn: a present-day family — parents and two kids — leans over open scriptures together at a kitchen table in warm evening lamplight, every face turned down toward the pages, a small child's finger on a line — seen from across the table at seated height. The same gospel, still arriving at tables.
must_show: a modern family bent together over open scriptures in lamplight, a child's finger on the page
must_not_show: readable text on the page, faces to camera, screens, brand marks

scene: Peace over the first altar: the hilltop at early light, empty again — the stones dark with old fire, a pair of doves lifting off into the brightening sky, mist thinning in the valley below. What began here has never stopped.
must_show: the empty ancient altar at early light with two doves lifting into the sky
must_not_show: people, fire burning, drawn rays, text
